reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives derive from a structured roster dataset where each entry encodes a player’s role within a team. The full-back assignment (FBA) is a deterministic mapping from player to position, modeled as a binary indicator in a role graph. The quarterback role probability (QRP) introduces stochasticity through player capability and game context. The position assignment graph (PAG) unifies these into a coherent bipartite structure. Dualities emerge in that FBA and QRP can be seen as projections of a larger latent role space. Failure modes include ambiguous role assignments, missing data, or mislabeled positions. These are mitigated by cross-referencing with external metadata such as team affiliations and geographical origins.
